platform.name: WARREN
platform.description: Field notes on websites where the form is the content: scroll-narratives, experiments, pages whose journey is the story. Every entry documents the mechanism — not just the link.

sites.title: DERIVE
sites.subtitle: the museum of derived pages
sites.author: WARREN
sites.mechanism: A museum-hub exhibiting self-contained web pages as exhibits: a Matrix-inspired narrative terminal (exhibit derive-matrix), a visit counter frozen at 000001 since 2003 (exhibit compteur-2003). Each page is standalone, under 6 KB, with easter eggs in the source code.
sites.why_here: The warren's first resident. Proof that a frozen, maintenance-free page can stay alive: the content never moves, the experience neither — and that's the point.
